items.text: \[Patch Introduction]
New Weapon: Lancaster

A four barreled, medium ammo pistol with a rotating firing pin which allows for a high fire rate. Favored by Hunters on safari as a self-defense weapon due to its superior reliability and stopping power. Opening the break-action will always eject all rounds.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
New Variant: Lancaster Cleaver
A variant of the Lancaster with an under-barrel blade, changing its melee attacks to be similar to a Heavy Knife in both swing pattern and damage.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
World
All Bileweaver Infested Compounds (new and Old) will have a chance to spawn in Chapter 3. There will be 5 compounds active per game.
Fair Play Follow Up
Players get a follow up notification when a player they reported was banned
Players get a Hunt Dollar refund when they get killed by a player who was banned
High ping queue (Temporary test in Europe for the duration of Chapter 3)

Players get matchmade into a separate queue if their ping is above a threshold. The goal is to reduce exposure to high-latency gameplay. Should they not be able to find a match, they rejoin the regular matchmaking queue.
\[Upcoming Updates]
New Community Event: “Reap the Harvest”

“Reap the Harvest” is a new Community Event that is planned to start later in Chapter 3. The Community Event will consist of 5 Stages, each offering a reward to the whole of the community. Players will progress the Community Event by earning Community Event Points which is done by completing objectives in matches.
Community Event Stage Rewards
Stage 1: 5K Hunt Dollars & 1K Event Points
Stage 2: Lancaster (New Weapon)
Stage 3: 10K Hunt Dollars & 2.5K Event Points
Stage 4: Lancaster Cleaver (New Weapon)
Stage 5: Random Legendary Skin

The Inferno Time of Day is back to Hunt, bringing wildfires raging across all maps. It comes with reduced visibility due to heavy smoke and wildfires in affected areas. Wildfires are fixed in location, blocking key traversal paths and forcing new route planning. AI will generally avoid wildfire zones, but if necessary, enemies may follow players through the flames or take shortcuts across them. Inferno will remain part of the active Time of Day Rotation throughout Chapters 2 and 3.
Firefighter Supply
This type of supply only appears during the Inferno Time of Day.
Find valuable rewards such as the Flame Rifle, Scouting Map, or Tarot Cards.
Flame Rifle
Scarce Weapon that releases pressurized liquid producing a steady burst of flames.
They are guaranteed to be found at the Firefighter Supply
The All Hallow’s Cleave Community Event consists of 5 Stages. Players will progress the Community Event by earning Community Event Points which is done by completing objectives in matches.
Stage 1: New Tarot Card: The Atlas
Reveals all hidden locations on the map.
Stage 3: New Tarot Card: The Temperance
Restores the last Trait lost by your hunter this mission.
Dev Note: Using the card also returns traits lost to Siphon, not just burn traits.
Stage 5: New Tool: Long Derringer
A small single-shot pistol that fires Long Ammo, which deals high damage with a reduced velocity and short drop range. More accurate from short to medium range.
The Flame Rifle will come in handy as the Bileweavers are making their comeback in Chapter 2. They have infested 20 new Compounds across all maps, 5 of which will be selected for each match.
We are also introducing their deadlier relatives, the Bloodweavers.
They are Bileweaver variations that cause Bleeding damage with their jump attack and egg-hatching.
Players can identify them by their red-colored body.
The color of Bileweaver Eggs has changed to better reflect their poisonous nature, and Bloodweaver Eggs inherit the red-colored ones with spikes.
They are only present during the Blood Moon Time of Day.
Bileweavers, Bloodweavers, and the infected new Compounds will all arrive with All Hallows’ Cleave on Oct 13th.

\[General Updates]
[p align="start"]Across all platforms
Fixed an issue where sprint controls could behave inconsistently when using a controller.
Fixed an exploit that could allow players to gain infinite Dark Sight under specific circumstances.
Fixed an audio issue where Bloodskin's teleport loop could remain audible near Boss Target compounds for some players.
Fixed an issue where various weapons and Tools did not contribute correctly to the "Written in Blood" Story Challenge goal "Kill Armoreds with: Piercing Damage."
Fixed missing menu slide SFX after selecting "View Details."
Fixed the “Lightfoot” Trait hint not correctly describing its interaction with the “Catalyst” Trait.
Fixed an issue where interacting with a single Trait could result in two Traits being sold.
Fixed an issue where the Battle Pass reward pop-up would not appear when earning Event Points without completing a goal.
Fixed an issue where the Burgess mechanical foley sounds could be too prominent while downed.
Fixed an issue where purchasing the Battle Pass through Event Details could incorrectly open the Community Event screen with a black background.
Fixed incorrect Storefront text for the "Sage of Joseon" DLC.
Fixed an issue where the scope on "Checks and Balances" was slightly smaller than the base Nitro Express scope.
Fixed an issue where shared Challenge progress did not update correctly when restoring a teammate's health.
Fixed an issue at First Testimonial Church where players could stand in a specific location and remain safe from Bloodskin's attacks.
Fixed an issue where unlocked "Blood Testament" Battle Pass Skins could not be equipped until their corresponding item variants had been unlocked.
Fixed an issue where teammate voice volume could become too quiet after enabling Proximity Chat in the settings.
Fixed an issue where the Burgess shotgun Equipment Animation would not play in the menu in some cases.
Fixed an issue on Steam where the "Buy Blood Bonds" option in the Equipment Animation side panel did not redirect players to the Steam Store.
Fixed an issue where newly created Newsfeed entries were not reliably displayed.
[p align="start"]
Console specific
Fixed an issue on PlayStation and Xbox where external links associated with promotions did not work correctly.
Fixed an issue on PlayStation where images could take an extended amount of time to load on the frontend.
Fixed an issue on PlayStation and Xbox that prevented players from assigning a Quick Slot button to the currently selected equipment item.
